what_this_proves: Memory retrieval can run on a real embedding provider behind the same Embedder seam the deterministic hash serves, chosen by configuration and reported honestly (a hash never calls itself semantic); a provider change is a new model id whose index is filled without touching canonical rows and without re-embedding what already exists; the owner can pin, unpin, forget (in two presses) and correct a memory from the page; and a question over a document, or a search across the indexed documents, ranks by meaning beside words under the same embedder.

measured_first.before: app/memory/embedding.py: DeterministicEmbedder only (seeded n-gram hash, dim 256, 'NOT a semantic model'); MemoryRuntime hard-wired it; /v1/system/health reported model_id deterministic-ngram with no notion of provider; lifecycle.reindex re-embedded every row; no unpin (pin only); the /memory page listed rows with no control; documents/retrieval.top_k ranked by token overlap only and no route searched across indexed documents. The corpus harness installs a fake voice OpenAI key for the realtime fake - the first B37 run selected OpenAI from it under 'auto' and every memory write in the harness hit the network (401): the selection was narrowed to the dedicated key.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations restored from sha256-verified copies (never git checkout); scratchpad b37_mutate.py.
mutations: M1 the provider is asked for its default width, not the index's -> 1 failure (dimensions missing from the request).
M2 a vector of the wrong width is stored into the fixed-width index -> 1 failure (no 'dimensions' refusal).
M3 'openai' without a key builds a provider anyway / 'auto' never falls back with a reason -> 1 failure (selection matrix).
M4 reindex_missing re-embeds every memory on every pass -> 1 failure (second pass wrote rows).
M5 unpin leaves the memory in the pinned retention class -> 1 failure (retention_class still pinned).
M6 the embedder is passed but never changes a document ranking -> 1 failure (semantic component / reranker).
M7 the health check calls the n-gram hash semantic -> 1 failure (semantic must be False).
red_first_proof.result: 7/7 red; every file restored to its sha256 before the mutation (M6 v1 was green: the reranker assertion only checked the winning ref, which words alone decided; it now asserts the embedder changes the score)

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the OpenAI provider against a recorded httpx transport (the exact request and the vector it returns), the selection and coverage on the real backend (SQLite), the routes through create_app with an owner session, the document search over the harness's indexed fixture. The roadmap's PROVEN_REAL (a semantic query after a re-index returns the right record on the deployed Cloud Core with the owner's key) is READY_FOR_OWNER: it needs PAGENTOS_OPENAI_API_KEY on the host (checkpoint 9) and the deploy.

owner_gates.embedding_provider: READY_FOR_OWNER (checkpoint 9): set PAGENTOS_OPENAI_API_KEY (scripts/secret-store.ps1 -Set / set-cloud-secret.ps1), leave memory_embedding_provider=auto, press 'Eksikleri indeksle' on /memory, ask a semantic question.
owner_gates.cost: the provider is billed per text; the in-process cache and the missing-only re-index keep it to what changed.
